xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:DisclosureOfNotesOnFinancialRe:
1. The Statement of unaudited consolidated financial results (“the Statement”) of SIS Limited (the “Parent” or “Company”), its subsidiaries and its joint venture entities (collectively known as the “Group”) for the quarter and six months ended September 30, 2026, have been reviewed by the Audit Committee and, thereafter, approved by the Board of Directors at its meeting held on November 04, 2026.

2. The limited review, as required under Regulation 33 and 52 read with 63 of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015, has been completed and the related Report does not have any impact on the 'Results and Notes' for the quarter and six months ended September 30, 2026, which needs to be explained.

3. The consolidated financial results have been prepared in accordance with the principles and procedures of Indian Accounting Standards (“Ind AS”) prescribed under Section 133 of the Companies Act, 2013 read with the Companies (Indian Accounting Standards) Rules, 2015 and in terms of the SEBI Master Circular for compliance with the provisions of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015 by listed entities, as amended and other recognised accounting practices and policies.

4. On November 21, 2025, the Government of India brought into effect the Code on Wages, 2019, the Industrial Relations Code, 2020, the Code on Social Security, 2020, and the Occupational Safety, Health and Working Conditions Code, 2020, consolidating 29 existing labour laws into a unified framework governing employee benefit during employment and post-employment.
During the quarter ended September 30, 2026, the Group continued to monitor to implementation of the aforesaid Labour Codes, including the applicable notifications, rules, amendments and clarifications issued by the Central Government and respective State Governments, The Group has undertaken appropriate action to implement the required changes accordingly and has assessed the consequential impact, if any, on its financial results.
5. During the quarter ended September 30, 2026, the Parent has allotted 45,473 equity shares of INR 5 each upon exercise of vested stock options by the eligible employees. Consequent to said allotment, the paid-up equity share capital of the Parent stood at INR 70,67,59,580 divided into 14,13,51,916 equity shares of INR 5 each.

6. Pursuant to the approval of the Board of Directors at its meeting held on August 05, 2026, the Parent approved a buyback of its fully paid up equity shares of a face value of INR 5/- each through the open market using the stock exchange mechanism, in accordance with the Securities and Exchange Board of India (Buy-Back of Securities) Regulations, 2018, as amended the applicable provisions of the Companies Act, 2013 and the rules made thereunder, at a price not exceeding INR 478.50/- per Equity Share (“Maximum Buyback Price”), payable in cash, for an aggregate amount not exceeding INR 106.00 crore, excluding expenses incurred in connection with the buyback. The buyback was funded from the Parent’s eligible reserves and other permitted sources, as applicable, in accordance with the applicable statutory requirements.

During the quarter ended September 30, 2026, the Parent purchased 21,74,134 equity shares under the aforesaid buyback by appropriating a sum of INR 91.64 crore from the securities premium, general reserves and retained earnings and an amount of INR 1.09 crore, equivalent to the nominal value of the equity shares bought back through the buyback, have been transferred to the capital redemption reserve account.

Subsequent to the reporting date and up to the date of approval of these financial results, the Parent purchased an additional 3,28,540 equity shares under the aforesaid buyback for an aggregate consideration of INR 13.27 crore. The buyback closed on October 16, 2026, upon utilisation of the Maximum Buyback Size, with 25,02,674 equity shares bought back in aggregate, all of which have been extinguished.

7. During the quarter ended 30 September, 2026, based on the recommendation of the Nomination and Remuneration Committee and the Board of directors, the shareholders, by way a of special resolution passed through postal ballot, approved the continuation of Mr. Arvind Kumar Prasad (DIN: 02865273) as Whole-time Director on the Board of the Parent upon attaining the age of 70 years on September 09, 2026, up to the expiry of his existing term on April 23, 2027, on the existing terms and conditions of his appointment.
xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:DisclosureOfNotesOnSegmentsExp:
The Group is currently focused on three business groups, viz., Security Services (India), Security Services (International) and Facility Management. The Group's organizational structure and governance processes are designed to support effective management of multiple businesses while retaining focus on each one of them. The Operating Segments have been reported in a manner consistent with the internal reporting provided to the Group Management Committee, which is the Chief Operating Decision Maker.

The business groups comprise the following:
Security Services (India) – Guarding, Electronic security and home alarm monitoring and response services
Security Services (International) – Guarding, Mobile patrols, Emergency medical response and rescue, Loss prevention and allied services
Facilities Management – Housekeeping, Cleaning, Facility operation & management and Pest control services
